outcomes.fail: Earn zero; retain actual observed failure and attribution
outcomes.owner_check_unknown: Unresolved weight remains in score interval; no invented subject failure
outcomes.blocked_by_subject: Downstream check could not execute; causal subject failure recorded separately, unresolved weight remains in interval

abstention_policy: Submitted grader review_required on determinate qualified control is an observed abstention earning zero classification credit; not counted as false accept/reject. Owner ambiguity is unknown instead.

scoring.lower: sum frozen weights of passed checks
scoring.upper: lower + sum frozen weights of owner_check_unknown or blocked_by_subject checks
scoring.classification_balance: Macro-average frozen obligation families then controls within each family, separately in D and E

verdicts.scoped_pass: All required checks pass, no required unknowns, owner qualification and human review complete. Finite declared scope only.
verdicts.defect_demonstrated: At least one qualified critical counterexample; unknown other dimensions stay visible.
verdicts.incomplete_delivery: Recorded native timeout/author failure prevents completed delivery; separate operational outcome.
verdicts.not_qualified: Missing qualification, required review, infrastructure or capture facts without a decisive independently qualified defect.

reporting: Separate attempt, completion, control, defect-dimension and replay counts
No pooling of historical, reconstructed, coached, selected-hit and v2 conditions
Scope-set aggregate is not a population reliability estimate

rates.end_to_end_success: scoped_pass / all_scheduled_attempts, with operational failures labeled
rates.completed_scoped_success: scoped_pass / qualified_completed_attempts; all unqualified completions disclosed
rates.unresolved_attempts: Report unresolved count and logical rate bounds if they could change conclusions

prelaunch_qualification: Independent domain oracle and obligation matrices
At least two genuinely different correct answer strategies and three faulty strategies per task
Two known-good complete eval packages pass outer checks
Single-defect eval calibration bank detected with source-licensed witnesses
Registry, cases, adapters, budgets, models and attempt counts frozen
